report:
Skin, left leg ulcer, punch biopsy

Received in formalin is a piece of skin labelled left leg ulcer, measuring 0.4 x 0.4 x 0.3 cm. All embedded in 1 block.

(1) Skin, all embedded.

Sections show skin at the edge of an ulcer, with reactive epidermal hyperplasia. The underlying dermis contains granulation tissue with mixed acute and chronic inflammatory infiltrates. There is no evidence of dysplasia or malignancy.

SKIN, left leg ulcer, punch biopsy - In keeping with ULCER EDGE
